reason: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin centered on an interactive blue-whale maid companion that provides task-status notifications, session navigation, local progression, and account-usage display.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中提供可互动的蓝鲸女仆桌面宠物，用于任务提醒、会话跳转、陪伴互动和 DeepSeek 用量查看。
summaries.en: Adds an interactive blue-whale maid desktop pet to DeepSeek Harness for task reminders, session navigation, companion interactions, and DeepSeek usage viewing.

capabilities: Displays an interactive animated desktop pet in the DeepSeek Harness web interface
Shows task completion, failure, confirmation, and long-running-task reminders
Reads and displays DeepSeek balance, daily usage, and current-session cost
Stores local progress such as completion points and unlocked dialogue
Navigates to the related conversation and supports click, double-click, and drag interactions
